subject.title: feat(sessions): upstream liveness for adopted catalog sessions

question: Should upstream monitoring become a permanent third-party Plugin SDK contract now, or remain an internal bundled-plugin seam until its generic identity and source-kind design is settled?
rationale: The PR adds compatibility-sensitive public API for provider identity and activity probing; repository policy and the open SessionObserver direction do not establish that this exact contract should be permanent.

options.title: Narrow internal seam first
options.body: Keep the monitoring seam internal to bundled plugins, make source kinds plugin-owned, and promote a generic public API only after another external consumer validates the design.

options.title: Approve public SDK now
options.body: Accept the public contract after fixing agent-qualified identity, plugin-defined kinds, ownership boundaries, documentation, and compatibility coverage.

options.title: Pause for SessionObserver
options.body: Leave the canonical issue open and defer this branch until the broader SessionObserver architecture owns the permanent contract.

recommendation.title: Narrow internal seam first
recommendation.body: Keep the monitoring seam internal to bundled plugins, make source kinds plugin-owned, and promote a generic public API only after another external consumer validates the design.

likelyOwner.reason: The merged feature history ties this person to the underlying state-awareness design and the canonical observed-session proposal.
